review:
Medusa's Stone is a Greek myth slot where the Medusa Spin feature can randomly turn character symbols on reels 2 to 4 into wilds in any base-game spin.

Three bonus symbols award 10 free spins. During a Medusa Spin in the bonus, transformed wilds carry 2x to 6x multipliers and stay on screen until they're used in a win, at which point their multipliers join a running total applied to that win and later wins with wilds. Three Super Bonus symbols during a Medusa Spin start Super Free Spins with 12 spins. Pragmatic Play advertises up to 7,000x. The RTP is 96.46%.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
